findings.Quote: Somewhere north, Nuru was living her life. Gravity.

findings.Quote: They arrived in her body before they reached her head, which was what made them fragments and not memories.

findings.Quote: the way a full breath arrives
findings.Note: Vague simile that doesn't clarify the sensation described; breath arriving isn't inherently 'whole' in a way that illuminates the feeling.

findings.Quote: the way you hold a name you check on before you can start your day

findings.Quote: the weight scraped out from behind her own words
findings.Note: abstract, unclear image — 'weight' and 'scraped out' don't cohere into a visualizable action, telling rather than showing what actually degraded
findings.Fix: Specify what physically or textually changed: e.g., 'the calibration had worn thin, and what she'd written no longer matched what she felt.'

findings.Quote: Four months was the wear-through, the page worn thin, the weight scraping loose and finding the crack in the wall.
findings.Note: Stacked metaphors (wear-through, worn page, scraping weight, crack in wall) pile on without adding precision — reads as purple overreach rather than earned insight.

findings.Quote: put a wall around her or paint a mark on her

findings.Quote: His had been cut to leave no afterimage.

findings.Quote: Partnership contacts heard you until they'd heard enough to check the box, then moved on with the box still warm.

findings.Quote: He had handed her own method back to her as a virtue, polished, and she felt the shape of it land.
